subject: Coffee & Tea
title: Direct Trade vs. Fair Trade
description: Learn Direct Trade vs. Fair Trade in one minute.

hook.text: Direct Trade skips certifications. Roasters visit farms, negotiate prices, and build long-term relationships.

buildup.text: Direct Trade often pays farmers 25–100% above Fair Trade prices by eliminating intermediary costs.

discovery.text: Without third-party auditing, Direct Trade relies on the roaster's integrity. There's no independent verification.

twist.text: Some roasters use 'Direct Trade' as marketing without actually visiting farms or paying premium prices.

climax.text: Both models try to fix the same problem—farmer poverty—but through different mechanisms with different flaws.

punchline.text: Labels promise fairness. The details determine if it's real.

quiz.question: What is the main criticism of Direct Trade?
options: There's no independent verification of claims
